description: Update an app name, description, tags, cover image, visibility status, custom domain URL, etc.

customThumbnailUrl.description: Custom cover image URL, pass null to reset to default

faviconUrl.description: Site favicon URL, only in-site upload URLs are accepted, pass null to clear

isVisible.description: Whether to show in public app list: 0 = hidden, 1 = visible

newPublicId.description: New custom publicId (6-36 chars, letters/numbers/hyphens only). Will be lowercased automatically.

publicId.description: The public ID of the app to update

name: wf_update_app
title: Update WeaveFox app
